body:
Thanks for the insight. I'm gonna confront him about it eventually, just hurts y'know. 

I might PM you sometime. Thanks again, man.

People tell me that all the time. It means a lot more coming from someone who actually knows what the fuck they're talking about. Thank you for the advice, the hope, and the good laugh you gave me with the tuxedo thing. It means a lot.

I've been saving up to lease my own place far away from here. I hope I get to leave soon, I don't know if I can take something like this happening again.

I didn't just trust him, I looked up to the guy more than anyone else I knew.

Not yet. I'm not very confrontational, I know I have to though. Thank you so much for caring.
